                    [--max-memory SIZE] [--max-context TOKENS]
                    [--ple-memory SIZE] [--expert-memory SIZE]
                    [--sparse-kv-memory SIZE] [--kv-format {int8,bf16}]
                    [--state-format {fp32,bf16}] [--idle-release DURATION]
                    [--max-cache-disk SIZE] [--max-cache-disk-writes SIZE]

                    [--default-reasoning-effort EFFORT]
                    [--thinking-token-budget N] [--thinking-end-text TEXT]

                    [--decode-share SHARE] [--disable-ane]
                    [--verify-rows {auto,all}] [--allow-idle-sleep]
splash serve: error: argument --port: port must be between 1 and 65535
